manualFallbackDefinition: A step or job explicitly constrained to github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' inside a workflow that also has pull_request or push triggers.
manualOnlyDefinition: Coverage in a workflow with workflow_dispatch but no pull_request/push trigger, or an explicitly workflow_dispatch-only job/step in such a workflow.

metricDefinitions.duplicate_units: Static coverage units owned by more than one workflow regardless of event/if conditions.
metricDefinitions.automatic_execution_duplicate_units: Coverage units with more than one owner that can execute on pull_request or push after event/if classification and Current Main canonical delegation.
metricDefinitions.manual_fallback_units: Distinct units that exist only in explicit workflow_dispatch fallback steps within otherwise automatic workflows.
metricDefinitions.manual_fallback_duplicate_units: Manual fallback units present in more than one workflow.
metricDefinitions.manual_only_units: Distinct units belonging only to workflow_dispatch-only execution paths.
metricDefinitions.automatic_verification_duplicate_units: Automatic duplicate units classified as verifier/check/audit/validate/guard scripts or verification-oriented npm scripts; infrastructure capabilities and setup/gate/materialization helpers are excluded.

compatibility.execution_duplicate_units: Alias of automatic_execution_duplicate_units for existing log consumers.

unitClasses.verification: Verifier/check/audit/validate/guard scripts and verification-oriented npm tasks.
unitClasses.execution_helper: Await/materialize/capture/configure/apply and other execution helper scripts.
unitClasses.syntax-verification: Node --check validation of a script file; tracked separately from executing that script.

transitiveExpansion.rule: Expand quoted child script paths only from scripts with executable child-process evidence: child_process import/reference plus spawnSync call.
transitiveExpansion.rationale: Structural verifiers may contain run(...) examples or quoted script paths for source assertions; those strings are coverage evidence, not executed children.

currentMainDelegationSemantics: Delegating a canonical contract suppresses both the top-level verifier script and its executable child-process transitive script closure from Current Main automatic execution ownership.
invocationSemantics: A `node --check path/to/script.mjs` occurrence contributes `syntax:<script>`, not `script:<script>`. Actual execution and syntax validation are distinct coverage units.
